etymology: Pictograph: a giant carpenter's square held at the middle — outsized: gigantic.
mnemonic: A ruler too big for any hand — キョ. 巨大: measured with that ruler.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 丩 (phonetic キョウ) — the voice wrung out at full force: to shout, scream.
mnemonic: The mouth twisted like a wrung towel — さけぶ. 叫び: the sound with no polite form.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 巩 (phonetic キョウ) + heart (心) — the heart gripped: fear, dread.
mnemonic: Something takes the heart in both hands and squeezes — おそれる. 恐竜: 'the dreadful dragons'; 恐れ入ります: fear, weaponized as politeness.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 夾 'one flanked by two' (phonetic キョウ) — held from both sides: to pinch, insert between.
mnemonic: Caught between finger and thumb — はさむ. The bookmark's whole career.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 兄 (phonetic キョウ) — how the waters stand: the state of things: situation.
mnemonic: Check the river's mood before crossing — キョウ. 状況: today's water report for everything.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 犭 + 夾 (phonetic キョウ) — squeezed from both sides: narrow, tight.
mnemonic: The alley the dog fills wall to wall — せまい. 狭い部屋: Tokyo's default setting.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 禺 (phonetic グウ) — a matched figure, a double: pair, even number; meetings that pair up by chance: accidental.
mnemonic: Bumping into your double at the corner — グウ. 偶然: coincidence, the universe's even numbers.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 禺 (phonetic グウ) — where the walls meet: a corner, a nook.
mnemonic: The angle the broom always misses — すみ. 隅々まで: into every last one.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 屈 'bent' (phonetic クツ) — bent over, working downward: to dig.
mnemonic: Back bent, dirt flying — ほる. 発掘: digging with a permit and a brush.

etymology: Phono-semantic: leather (革) + 化 (phonetic カ) — hide transformed for the feet: shoes, boots.
mnemonic: Leather reincarnated (化) as footwear — くつ. 靴を脱ぐ: the threshold ritual.

etymology: Compound: person (亻) + 頃 'head atilt' — the whole figure tipping: to lean, incline.
mnemonic: The tower, the listener, the argument: all tipping — かたむく. 傾向: which way things lean lately.

etymology: Compound: a generous heart (心) beneath — kindness bestowed: favor, blessing.
mnemonic: The heart that gives without invoicing — めぐみ. 知恵: the mind's version of the gift.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 卬 'facing up' (phonetic ゲイ) — going out to meet: to welcome.
mnemonic: Down the path to meet them halfway — むかえる. お迎え: the pickup at the station, the kanji of waiting parents.

etymology: Compound: the body's door-frame (戸) of flesh (月) — where loads hang: the shoulder.
mnemonic: The body's lintel — かた. 肩こり: the lintel complaining, nationally.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 臤 'capable' (phonetic ケン) + 貝 — capability worth treasure: wise, clever.
mnemonic: Smart enough that people pay for the opinion — かしこい. 賢い: the compliment with interest.

etymology: Phono-semantic: cart (車) + 干 (phonetic ケン) — originally the carriage's raised canopy; the house's overhang: eaves; houses counted by their eaves.
mnemonic: Count the rooflines down the street — けん. 一軒, 二軒: houses tallied by their hat brims.

etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 古 'old' (phonetic コ) — the tree gone old and dry: to wither.
mnemonic: The tree that turned to paper standing up — かれる. 枯れ葉: autumn's confetti.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 戸 (phonetic コ) + bird (隹) — originally a migratory bird whose seasons set farm work: to hire.
mnemonic: The bird shows up each season, and gets put on payroll — やとう. 雇用: employment, feathers optional.

etymology: Pictograph: two hooks meshed together — each holding the other: mutual, reciprocal.
mnemonic: Neither hook works alone — たがい. お互いに: the handshake, drawn.

etymology: Compound: attending on the move (彳) — managing the lord's horses; the honorific prefix (御〜, お/ご) grown from that service.
mnemonic: The polish applied before any noun meets a superior — ご, お, ギョ. ご飯, お茶, 御社: service in prefix form.

etymology: Pictograph: the night-watch drum struck again — the watch renewed: to renew; still more: further; deep into the night (更ける).
mnemonic: Another watch, another drumbeat — さらに. 更新: hitting refresh, formally.

etymology: Phono-semantic: stone (石) + 更 (phonetic コウ) — stone-firm: hard, stiff.
mnemonic: Refreshed and still rock solid — かたい. 硬貨: coins, the hard kind of money.

etymology: Compound: the meat that yields at the joint (止+月) — where things give way: to consent, affirm.
mnemonic: The joint bends: yes — コウ. 肯定: agreement with a grammar section.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 艹 + 巟 'flood over lost land' (phonetic コウ) — fields gone to weed and water: wild, rough.
mnemonic: The farm after ten years of nobody — あらい. 荒れる: weather, skin, and meetings all do it.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 交 (phonetic コウ) + city (阝) — where town crosses into country: the suburbs.
mnemonic: The last crosswalk before the fields — コウ. 郊外: commuter-belt kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 要 (phonetic ヨウ — itself originally a waist) — the body's pivot restored to flesh: hips, lower back.
mnemonic: 要 was the waist all along; add the body and it aches — こし. 腰が痛い: the pivot filing a complaint.

etymology: A kokuji — made in Japan: movement (辶) + enter (入) — pressing in: crowded; the 'into' of compound verbs (申し込む, 詰め込む).
mnemonic: Everyone entering at once, nobody exiting — こむ. 申込み: pressing yourself into a form.

etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 昏 'dusk' (phonetic コン) — weddings were held at dusk in ancient China: marriage.
mnemonic: The ceremony timed to the sunset — コン. 結婚: two threads tied at dusk.

etymology: Compound: the year-star's full circuit marked off — one completed year: age (〜歳), the year's close.
mnemonic: One more ring on the trunk — サイ. 二十歳: twenty rings, special reading, はたち.

etymology: Originally a variant of 笑 'laugh' — in Japanese the laughter settled on flowers: to bloom.
mnemonic: The bud laughs open — さく. 桜が咲く: the country's favorite sentence each April.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 司 (phonetic シ) — attending on a superior to inquire: to visit or ask, humbly.
mnemonic: Knocking softly at the director's door — うかがう. 伺います: 'I shall present myself' — keigo's house call.

etymology: Compound: a thorned branch (朿) + blade (刂) — the point that goes in: to stab, pierce; a calling card (名刺) 'stuck' on arrival.
mnemonic: Thorn plus knife: pointed twice over — さす. 刺身: pierced fresh; 名刺: pierced into memory.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 旨 'tasty' (phonetic シ) — the delicious part of the meat: fat, grease.
mnemonic: The marbling that makes wagyu wagyu — あぶら. 脂: flavor's guilty address.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 濕): water (氵) + a phonetic — moisture soaked in: damp, humid.
mnemonic: Laundry that refuses to finish drying — しめる. 湿気: June in Japan, bottled.

etymology: Pictograph: a small dugout boat seen from above, thwarts drawn in — a boat; the humble original of 船.
mnemonic: The rowboat before shipbuilding got ideas — ふね. 小舟: the pictograph, still afloat.

etymology: Compound: wood (木) supple enough for a spear-shaft (矛) — bending without breaking: soft, gentle.
mnemonic: The sapling the spear is cut from: strength that bends — やわらかい. 柔道: winning by yielding.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 者 (phonetic ショ/チョ) — the thread's end you grasp first: a cord, a beginning; ties of feeling (情緒).
mnemonic: Find the loose end and everything follows — お. 一緒: two ends of the same cord.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 刀 (phonetic ショウ) + mouth (口) — the call from above: to summon; in keigo, the honored doing of eating and wearing (召し上がる).
mnemonic: The order that arrives with authority behind it — めす. 召し上がれ: 'be summoned to eat' — dinner, elevated.

etymology: Compound: wood (木) laid under the roof (广) — the raised planks one sleeps on: floor, bed.
mnemonic: Boards up off the dirt: civilization's first mattress — ゆか, とこ. 床屋: the barber, from the shop's raised floor.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sun (日) + 升 (phonetic ショウ) — the sun climbing by measured degrees: to ascend, rise.
mnemonic: The sun taking the stairs — のぼる. 昇進: your own measured sunrise at work.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 召 (phonetic ショウ) — tying one person's thread to another's: to introduce.
mnemonic: Two strangers, one knot — ショウ. 紹介: matchmaking at the thread level.

etymology: Compound (simplified from 疊): mats folded and layered — the tatami; to fold up (畳む); rooms measured in mats.
mnemonic: The floor sold by the mat — たたみ. 六畳: six mats, one Tokyo apartment.

etymology: Phono-semantic: horn (角) + 虫 (phonetic ショク) — the feeler reaching out: to touch, to contact.
mnemonic: Antenna meets surface — さわる. お手を触れないでください: museums vs. this kanji, forever.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 申 'stretching bolt' (phonetic シン) — the body drawn long: to stretch, extend.
mnemonic: Arms up, spine crackling like lightning — のびる. 背伸び: stretching for the top shelf, literally and socially.

etymology: Compound: under the roof (宀), onto the bed-plank (爿) — laid down: to sleep.
mnemonic: Roof, bed, done — ねる. 寝坊: this kanji winning against your alarm.

etymology: Pictograph: the tattooing needle of punishment — sharp pain: bitter, harsh; on the tongue: spicy.
mnemonic: The needle on your tongue — からい; the needle in your week — つらい. Same kanji, two stings.
